videos.title: Documentary 360
videos.description: Anatomist Yoro Takeshi has spent decades exploring life and death. Now confronting his own mortality after a cancer diagnosis, what thoughts does he have to share on the nature of human existence? (Senderinfo).

videos.title: NHK NEWSLINE
videos.description: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Encounters with Art
videos.description: Yayoi Kusama creates original costumes she regards as the source of her creativity. This program follows the artist at work and explores the ideas behind her art. Originally aired in Japan in 2001. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: The CAT'S EYE MUSEUM
videos.description: World-famous artist Yayoi Kusama is known for polka dots. A giant pumpkin, mysterious ladder, and a chandelier expand into infinity. Explore her world with two unusual cats. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: The World Heritage Sites in Japan
videos.description: From natural landscapes to historic architecture representing centuries of cultural development, Japan's World Heritage sites offer a wide range of glimpses into history and the beauty of nature. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: NHK NEWSLINE
videos.description: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: GRAND SUMO LIVE
videos.description: NHK WORLD-JAPAN will broadcast GRAND SUMO November Tournament Day 14 action live from Fukuoka, as top wrestlers have their fourteenth bouts of the 15-day contest. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: NHK NEWSLINE
videos.description: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Design X Stories
videos.description: Today's theme: The New Era of Japanese Modern Design. A fusion of rational Western Modernism and traditional Japanese materials and skills. Explore the beauty and potential of Japanese Modern Design. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Story Land
videos.description: Leading actors take turns as solo storytellers to act and recite traditional folk tales loved in Japan for centuries. Watch out, too, for the delightful illustrations! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Texico
videos.description: Learn the principles of programming without a computer. Animated characters provide fun and lucid explanations of 5 core processes: analysis, combination, generalization, abstraction, and simulation. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: NHK NEWSLINE
videos.description: NHK Newsline delivers the latest international and regional news from Japan and around the world. The program features breaking developments, political and economic updates, and in-depth reports, providing viewers with reliable information and clear analysis of major global events. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: CYCLE AROUND TAIWAN
videos.description: The second episode of our Taiwan series features indigenous cultures in the south and on the east coast. We meet a Rukai man preserving the forest and Bunun people with a stunning choral tradition. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: NHK NEWSLINE
videos.description: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: BOSAI: Science that Can Save Your Life
videos.description: Tokyo Skytree, one of Japan's most famous tourist attractions, is equipped with a variety of countermeasures against disasters. We'll go behind the scenes to explore the tower's advanced technologies. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: DESIGN MUSEUM JAPAN
videos.description: Fukasawa Naoto (Product designer) visits Shimane. Red "Sekishu" roof tiles are perfectly suited to cold, snowy regions. Fukasawa considers design that embodies the community it comes from. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: KABUKI KOOL
videos.description: This is a family tragedy during a civil war where two brothers fight on opposing sides, both brilliant strategists. The story takes place against the real historical background. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Trails to Oishii Tokyo 10min.
videos.description: In squid-loving Japan, spear squid is immensely popular. Tag along with fishers in Hokkaido and savor some regional cuisine, fresh sushi, and a special take on a beloved Italian-inspired inky dish. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Hit the Road 5minutes
videos.description: Let's see Japan by car! We'll be driving through Hiroshima Prefecture, with our goal being the famed Itsukushima Shrine. Along the way, we'll make a few stops off the beaten path that will amaze you! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE
videos.description: Summer is winding down, and tonight down by Edo Bay the streets are filled with professional entertainers, food sellers, and revelers. It's getting late, but this party is just getting started. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: GRAND SUMO Highlights
videos.description: NHK WORLD-JAPAN presents a sumo highlights program for fans around the globe. Today the show features all top-division bouts from November 21, Day 14 of the Grand Sumo Tournament in Fukuoka. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Sumopedia #22
videos.description: Sumopedia enriches your sumo experience with information on the techniques, traditions and famous wrestlers of the past. The rules may be simple but there is a lot more to sumo than meets the eye. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: J-MELO
videos.description: Tune in to J-MELO for great Japanese music! This week: Aoi Eir (an anisong diva with a brand-new release) and GPP (an 8-piece all-female group with their sights on going international). (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Little Charo
videos.description: Little Charo is an animation series about a Japanese dog who got lost in NY. "I want to see my owner again!" Charo starts his adventure back home. Season 2-11. (Senderinfo).

videos.description: Family restaurants are uniquely Japanese establishments, popular not only with families but also with solo diners these days. They offer a wide array of creative dishes and a fun dining experience. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: A Cat's-Eye View of Japan
videos.description: A cat patrols Ogaki Castle and has a special place where he cools off on hot days. In Magome-juku, a 400-year-old post town, two cats live at a souvenir store. We capture an unexpected interaction! (Senderinfo).

videos.description: In Uda, discover Japan's oldest private medicinal herb garden, where the natural landscape from 300 years ago is preserved in a botanical time capsule, a sanctuary of the local culture and history. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: The Masterpieces of Ukiyo-e producer Tsutaju
videos.description: This miniseries presents the masterpieces of Tsutaju, a brilliant ukiyo-e producer of the Edo period. This episode features ukiyo-e artist Sharaku's "The Actor Ichikawa Ebizo as Takemura Sadanoshin." (Senderinfo).

videos.title: BOSAI: Science that Can Save Your Life
videos.description: Tokyo Skytree, one of Japan's most famous tourist attractions, is equipped with a variety of countermeasures against disasters. We'll go behind the scenes to explore the tower's advanced technologies. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change the World
videos.description: Due to global warming, the bamboo habitat range in Japan is expanding and abandoned bamboo groves are encroaching on forests and farmland nationwide. How should we associate with this iconic plant? (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Time-lapse Japan
videos.description: A 700-year-old hot spring, Shirabu Onsen, is maintained via daily trips up the slopes of the 2,000-meter mountain where it sits. See the hot spring's guardian at work, in gorgeous time-lapse footage. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
videos.description: Participants of the Hyoge Festival clown around in fun, silly costumes. It originated as a sly way of thanking a local hero, who built reservoirs but was exiled in the 17th century. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Nun's Cookbook
videos.description: The nuns of Otowasan Kannonji Temple teach us how to make shinoda rolls with taro stalks, a simple fall dish suitable for festive occasions. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Magical Japanese
videos.description: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture. This episode looks at words related to the night. Explore the unique culture behind them. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Easy Japanese
videos.description: #48 When I graduate, I want to work in Japan.; To explain your plan, say a verb in the "ta" form followed by "ra," to indicate the circumstance, and then whatever your plan is. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Culture Crossroads
videos.description: Hana no Kai is an elderly day care facility in Kobe that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. It makes the lives of those living out their final years in a foreign land more active and dignified. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: HELLO!NHK WORLD JAPAN
videos.description: Following the passing of Yayoi Kusama on August 14, NHK WORLD-JAPAN looks back on her life and artistic legacy through rare archival footage and past NHK programs. (Senderinfo).

videos.description: #46 It's small but beautiful.; Connect 2 opposing adjectives by using "kedo" (but) followed by "desu ne." (Senderinfo).

videos.description: Sawara Taisai looks back 300 years to a time when the town of Sawara was a vibrant cultural center. Large, elaborately decorated floats are paraded through the streets. (Senderinfo).

videos.description: Locals have slurped down bowls of noodles at a 24-hour ramen restaurant in Fukuoka for five decades. For three days, we asked customers why this simple ramen is more than just a cheap meal. (Senderinfo).

videos.description: Every minute counts in ischemic stroke care. Japanese researchers are developing a drug that could extend the treatment window from 4.5 to 12 hours. We also introduce stroke prevention indicator. (Senderinfo).
